title: 早上草叶上的水珠
subtitle: 露水和霜是从哪儿来的
character: wearing a lavender purple hoodie, grey sweatpants and green rubber boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel drawing with velvety blended tones and a gentle grain, dawn lilac, misty green and pale gold

pages.zh:
早上去上学，
草叶上全是水珠。
昨天晚上没下雨呀。
这些水珠到底
是从哪儿来的？
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up crouching beside a dewy lawn in the early morning, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, puzzled.

pages.zh:
空气里一直有水，
只是看不见。
它散成极小的粒，
小得看不出来，
混在空气中间。

草叶是凉的。
凉东西旁边的空气，
也跟着凉下来。
一凉下来，
它就装不下那么多水。
pages.scene: A close view of green grass blades in the early morning with round clear water drops resting on them, the grass filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
空气像个口袋。
热的时候口袋大，
装得下很多水；
凉下来口袋就小了，
装不下的只好出来。

夜里为什么会凉？
因为地面这一晚，
一直在往天上放热。
天上没云的夜，
放得最痛快。
pages.scene: A wide grass lawn at night under a clear sky full of small stars, the sky filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有云的夜就不同。
热往上走，
被云挡回来一半。
所以阴天的早上，
草叶常常是干的。

水汽碰到凉叶子，
就停在上面，
一粒一粒并起来，
变成一颗水珠。
这就是露水。
pages.scene: A very close view of one green blade of grass holding a single large round clear water drop, soft green blur filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
露水不是天上掉的，
也不是草根里冒的。
它本来就在
叶子旁边的空气里，
只是现出了形。

要是更冷呢？
冷过结冰那条线，
水汽就不停成水珠，
直接变成冰，
贴在叶子上。
pages.scene: A wide field of grass stiff and white with frost in the first light of morning, the field and the pale sky filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那就是霜。
霜不是冻住的露，
是水汽一步跨过去，
直接长成的冰。

太阳一出来，
草叶就暖了。
水珠一颗颗变小，
又回到空气里，
像从来没有过。
pages.scene: A low morning sun just above a grass field with the last water drops shining on the blades, the field and the glowing sky filling the whole picture right out to all four edges. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我伸手在草叶上
抹了一下，
手心凉凉地湿了。
这一小片水，
昨晚一直在我旁边。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up holding up one open palm wet with dew, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, smiling a little.
